articles.title: Trump Lights a Diya in the Oval Office as Governors Mark Diwali Across the US
articles.excerpt: President Donald Trump hosted a Diwali celebration in the Oval Office on Friday and was gifted a Hanuman Chalisa, while governors from Washington to Nebraska issued proclamations honouring Indian American contributions, ANI reported.
articles.image_caption: The Oval Office at the White House, photographed in 2017. President Donald Trump lit a diya in the Oval Office on Friday during the White House Diwali celebration.
articles.nri_angle: Diwali is now marked at the highest levels of US government, from a presidential diya-lighting in the Oval Office to gubernatorial proclamations in at least five states, a measure of the Indian American community's civic standing.

articles.title: Diwali Enters State Capitols And City Halls Across Pacific Northwest
articles.excerpt: Five governors hosted first-ever official Diwali celebrations, 22 Washington cities lit lamps in council chambers, and President Trump marked the festival in the Oval Office.
articles.image_caption: Diwali
articles.nri_angle: Official Diwali celebrations at five state capitols, 22 Washington city halls and the Oval Office mark formal civic recognition of nearly 200,000 Indian Americans in Greater Seattle alone and of the diaspora nationally.
